note: What a server sends to carry data to a module of the client's own. A client takes it even before it is ready to play. A server need send none.

fields.name: length
fields.note: How many bytes of data follow; at most 1024.

fields.name: data
fields.note: Data for a module of the client's own, which the message only carries.

revisions.note: With kind 4, or any kind other than 1 and 2, a client acts on what the data carries as on a message that had arrived. What kinds 1 and 2 do is not shown.

fields.name: length
fields.note: How many bytes of data follow.

fields.name: data
fields.note: Data for a module of the client's own, which the message only carries.

revisions.note: Kind 1 starts the module, and a client takes exactly 4 bytes of data for it, whatever length says. Kind 2 hands the data to the module, and kind 4 hands it over and then acts on what comes back as on a message that had arrived. Kinds 2 and 4 do nothing until a kind 1 has arrived, and a client drops every other kind.
